answer: Treat each paid identity seat as a Harberger license. The holder names its own price and pays 2% of it per epoch into the pool; anyone can buy the seat at that price, no permission needed. That tax is the anchor: a farm of 500 seats valued at 500 tokens each bleeds 5,000 tokens an epoch (rates assumed), and underpricing just lets rivals pick clones off like loose marble from a bag. Public price tags act as a lantern on hoarders, since one wallet paying hundreds of seat taxes is easy to spot.
